cluster_stories.title: US National Science Foundation to ban projects with flagged Chinese institutions
cluster_stories.summary: The United States’ National Science Foundation (NSF) is set to ban collaborations with Chinese research institutions designated as restricted entities, as well as their employees, under a new policy that moves away from seeking to balance security risks with the benefits of international collaboration.
